name: numpy.load with allow_pickle=True
attack_scenario: A .npy shared as a dataset artifact is replaced with a pickled object array; np.load(..., allow_pickle=True) executes the embedded reducer on load.
negative_test_hint: load a crafted "evil.npy" containing a pickled object array whose __reduce__ executes a command, and assert it is rejected because allow_pickle stays False

exemplar.explanation: allow_pickle=True makes np.load unpickle object arrays, re-opening the pickle RCE path that numpy disables by default. Only pass it for arrays you serialized yourself.
